text: From: New York Law360 <news-alt@law360.com> To: = Subject: Greenberg Traurig's NY Bill May Aid Russian Oligarch Client Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2021 09:02:15 +0000 ly Law360 New York NEW YORK Thursday, June 17, 2021 TOP NEWS Greenberg Traurig's NY Bill May Aid Russian Oligarch Client Greenberg Traurig successfully lobbied for a New York state bill that will make it harder to enforce foreign judgments, which could be worth $700 million or more to a Vladimir Putin-linked Russian oligarch who is a client of the firm. The state senator who sponsored the bill had no idea.
